plugin.name: Sandbox Sample
plugin.description: 示例沙箱插件：在 iframe 内演示宿主能力调用与权限申请（只读画布 + AI 生图）。

source: (function(){var rpc=window.__PluginRuntime;console.log('[sandbox-sample] iframe sandbox loaded; origin='+location.origin);function fail(e){console.error('[sandbox-sample] demo failed:',e);rpc.emit('sample:error',{message:String((e&&e.message)||e)});}rpc.emit('sample:ready',{});rpc.call('getNodes').then(function(nodes){console.log('[sandbox-sample] getNodes ->',nodes);return rpc.call('getConnections');}).then(function(conns){console.log('[sandbox-sample] getConnections ->',conns);console.log('[sandbox-sample] requesting ai.generateImage (triggers permission prompt)...');return rpc.call('ai.generateImage',{prompt:'a small red circle on a white background'});}).then(function(res){console.log('[sandbox-sample] ai.generateImage ->',res);rpc.emit('sample:done',{ok:true,images:(res&&res.images)?res.images.length:0});}).catch(fail);})();
